intent: Upload the finished iOS production/store IPA to App Store Connect/TestFlight without submitting the app for public review.
command: npx eas-cli@20.0.0 submit --platform ios --profile production --id 815a726d-7dfc-4cfa-a38d-e9757b5aafb1 --non-interactive --no-wait --what-to-test "ReversR Rebuild validates machine inventory matching, BOM generation, assembly steps, and quote packet handoff."

appStoreConnectScreen.section: Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API
appStoreConnectScreen.visibleGate: Permission is required to access the App Store Connect API. You can request access on behalf of your organization.
appStoreConnectScreen.actionTaken: Opened the exact App Store Connect API access screen and stopped before clicking Request Access.

humanInTheLoopGate.whyRequired: EAS Submit needs App Store Connect API key access to upload the finished iOS IPA to App Store Connect/TestFlight in non-interactive mode. App Store Connect currently requires the account holder to request API access for the organization.
humanInTheLoopGate.riskBoundary: Requesting API access and creating/downloading API keys creates persistent account access. Codex did not click Request Access, create a key, download a private key, upload the IPA, or submit the app for review.
nextHumanAction: In Chrome, stay on App Store Connect at Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API.
Click Request Access if you approve enabling App Store Connect API access for the organization.
If Apple shows terms or an access confirmation, read it and approve only if you agree.
After access is granted, create or authorize an App Store Connect API key suitable for EAS Submit, or tell Codex: Authorized: request App Store Connect API access and create the EAS submit key.
Do not click Add for Review or submit the app for public App Review.
